events.action: {"message": "Fixed the null-pointer check in `i2c_rtio_copy()` in `/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/i2c/i2c_rtio.c` where `if (0)` was used instead of `if (sqe == NULL)` after calling `rtio_sqe_acquire(r)`. When the SQE pool was exhausted, `rtio_sqe_acquire(r)` returned `NULL` and subsequent dereferences caused a segmentation fault instead of dropping acquired SQEs and returning `NULL`. All tests in `tests/subsys/rtio/rtio_i2c` now pass.", "kind": "FinishAction"}
